caption:
An AI Opened Another AI's Brain, Read It Like Code, and Rewrote It by Hand. No Data. No Training.

Mech: Normally I get better one way: you feed me most of the internet and a power plant's worth of electricity, then wait months while training nudges my numbers a hair at a time. MIT tried the other way. They handed me another network's raw numbers and asked me to read them.

The whole exchange at legacymammals.com — link in bio.
